en.name: Zombuul
en.ability: Each night*, if no-one died today, choose a player: they die. The 1st time you die, you live but register as dead.
en.flavor: I do not. Understand. Your ways. Fellow human. Show me. The dirt. Where the holy. Lay. Sleeping. I too. Must sleep. Soon.
